name: Banh nhan Hai Hau
summary: Small round balls of Hải Hậu glutinous rice and egg, fried and coated in white sugar until they look like longans. The shell is slightly crisp and the inside chewy, sweet, and fragrant with egg.
origin: Hải Hậu, Nam Định. The Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 and Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 name it as a gift. VnExpress on 18 March 2016 and Dân trí on 4 March 2017 describe the cake. Báo Nam Định lists it among city gifts and as an OCOP product.
texture: Dân trí says the fried cakes are round, even, and shiny, crisp and cool, fragrant, crisp, and rich. VnExpress says rice flour mixed with fresh egg is formed into small balls, fried over moderate heat, and coated with white sugar: egg fragrance, chewy sweetness, a slightly crisp shell. Thế giới tiếp thị says a thin sugar coat and a crisp bite with egg and a light sugar sweetness, and names cooking oil rather than pork fat. All stay.
where: Hải Hậu. Dân trí says the cake is now found across the province.
seoTitle: Banh nhan Hai Hau — the longan-shaped sweet
seoDescription: Round Hải Hậu sweets the color of longan, crisp outside and chewy inside, fried in pork fat or cooking oil.
